zh.title: 航空事件彙整：四起獨立事件涉及煞車、起落架與跑道偏出
zh.summary: 四起獨立航空事件涉及煞車、起落架、行動電源與跑道偏出
body: 以下彙整四起彼此獨立的航空事件，沒有資料指出事件間有關聯。The Aviation Herald報導了以下情況。
1. The Aviation Herald報導，Mesa E175於2026年10月26日在Houston發生煞車與轉向問題。
2. The Aviation Herald報導，United波音737 MAX 9（ICAO機型代碼B39M）於2026年10月25日在Houston出現起落架不安全狀況。
3. The Aviation Herald報導，Hong Kong空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）於2026年10月25日航程中發生行動電源熱失控。
4. The Aviation Herald報導，Jet2波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年10月25日在Birmingham短暫偏出跑道。

en.title: Aviation Incident Roundup Covers Four Independent Events on Oct. 25–26, 2026
en.summary: Four independent incident reports cite brake, gear, power-bank and runway-excursion events.
body: The four events in this roundup are independent, with no stated relationship among them. The Aviation Herald reported each as an incident.
1. The Aviation Herald reported brake and steering problems involving a Mesa E175 at Houston on October 26, 2026.
2. It reported an unsafe-gear incident involving United Boeing 737 MAX 9 (ICAO type code B39M) at Houston on October 25, 2026.
3. It reported a power-bank thermal runaway enroute involving Hong Kong Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) on October 25, 2026.
4. It reported a temporary runway excursion involving a Jet2 Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) at Birmingham on October 25, 2026.
